_finding: Owner, 25.11: a token list for wallets. A wallet that imports it shows every entry as a token to buy, so what it may hold is the whole point: only issuer-listed tokens with known decimals, never an impostor, names inside the format's rules, and nothing from a stale issuer list.

mutations.name: a listed token with no known decimals is let in
mutations.expect: FAIL only listed tokens with known decimals are in it

mutations.name: addresses are served lower-case, not checksummed
mutations.expect: FAIL addresses are checksummed, as wallets expect

mutations.name: characters outside the format's set are kept in names
mutations.expect: FAIL characters outside the set are dropped

mutations.name: a long name is not cut
mutations.expect: FAIL a name over 40 characters is cut at a word

mutations.name: the schema check lets a bad name through
mutations.expect: FAIL ...and those checks do catch a broken entry

mutations.name: the schema check lets a duplicate through
mutations.expect: FAIL ...and those checks do catch a broken entry

mutations.name: the version no longer moves with the read time
mutations.expect: FAIL the version is the read time
